featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently hosted our daughter’s 5th birthday at The Legacy Banquet at Witty International School and the experience was truly wonderful from start to finish. The venue itself has a very luxurious and elegant feel, making it a perfect place to host a special celebration. I can not express in words how beautiful the whole experience was 🙌🏻

A special appreciation goes to Manish Bhai for the absolutely stunning décor. Every detail was thoughtfully planned and executed, and the setup looked elegant, vibrant and picture-perfect. The entire look of the event  created a memorable atmosphere especially for my daughter and for everyone present. The theme of ‘Princess  Mysha in THE FROZEN WORLD’ just looked perfect.

The overall operations and coordination were handled seamlessly by Saurabh, who ensured that everything ran smoothly throughout the event. His professionalism, responsiveness, and ability to manage things efficiently made the entire experience stress-free for us.

When it comes to the food, it was truly one of the highlights of the evening. The menu was thoughtfully curated and the quality of every dish was excellent. A big thank you to Rajiv Velker, who was the overall food in-charge, for ensuring that everything was perfectly planned and executed. The food was delicious, beautifully presented and  widely appreciated by our guests at the end of the event. Rajiv ji just told me one thing at the end I just wanted everyone to be happy and he added lots of dishes by him self to enhance the overall experience 🙌🏻

Special mention to Tirupati Dingale, the F&B In-charge, for managing the service so efficiently and ensuring that everything was well organized and timely. The service team was attentive, courteous, and very well coordinated. They were constantly on their toes to serve everyone and were present at almost every table, something we rarely see these days. The entire team was so well trained that every guest felt personally attended to and genuinely cared for throughout the event. (My friends and family actually called me to mention this)

A heartfelt appreciation also goes to Head Chef Hemant Sawant, whose culinary expertise truly reflected in the taste and quality of the dishes served. Every item was prepared with great care and flavour, leaving a lasting impression on our guests. (Guests personally came up to us to mention how amazing the food was)

Another aspect worth highlighting is the excellent hygiene and cleanliness maintained throughout the venue. Everything was kept extremely neat and well managed, which added to the comfort and overall positive experience of the event.

From the luxurious ambiance and beautiful décor to the exceptional food and smooth management, every aspect of our event at The Legacy Banquet was handled with great professionalism and dedication. We would highly recommend this venue to anyone looking for a place that offers elegance, quality and outstanding service with wide variety of food.

I truly feel that when my daughter grows up and looks back at the pictures and memories of her celebration, she will say, “My parents chose a place that made my special day look like a dream.”

Once again a big Thank you to the entire team of Legacy Banquets 🙏🏻🙌🏻
Honestly, I wish there was an option to give more than just 5 stars 🌟, because the team truly deserves it.

With Love and gratitude,
Pooja Suchak & Shyam Suchak

Dear Vishal Hall Banquet Team,
I would like to share my feedback regarding the recent event we hosted at your venue.
Firstly, I truly appreciated the food quality, which was excellent, and the cleanliness, which was well-maintained throughout the event.
My ratings are as follows:
Food: 10/10
Service: 9/10 (slightly slow at times)
I would also like to appreciate the management person Akshay for his guidance throughout the process. Additionally, Mr. Abhishek and Mr. Naren did a commendable job in managing the food arrangements, and I sincerely thank them for their efforts.

However, I was extremely disappointed with the decor arrangements, which did not match the commitments made during booking. I genuinely felt that the amount paid for decor did not justify the final outcome. Here are the specific issues:
1. The decor was supposed to be fully ready by 5 PM so I could review everything and ensure it was up to the mark. However, the setup was only completed around 6 PM, by which time I was already occupied with other arrangements. This left no opportunity for a proper final check or to request timely corrections.
2. Old soft toys were used in the decor. They were so worn-out that I had to request their removal—and no replacement was provided.
3. The magic show & puppet show, which were clearly discussed and included in the deal, were changed without any prior information or approval. They were replaced with a “mind show,” which was never agreed upon.
4. The car provided was completely different from what was promised. We had booked a white, new Maybach, but what arrived was an old, damaged white car with a broken safety belt. This was highly unprofessional.
Overall, I would rate the Decor: POOR, and I genuinely felt betrayed by the lack of transparency and failure to deliver what was promised.

I would like to know who is responsible for these shortcomings and request appropriate compensation for the inconvenience and for not delivering the committed services.
I hope you will address this matter seriously and respond at the earliest.
Regards,
Sanjay Gupta

featured_reviews.review_text: The ambience is good but the service and taste of food was not to the mark. The valet service was also unprofessional and rude. featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Sir,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We genuinely regret that your experience as a guest did not meet your expectations. However, we would like to clarify a few points for better context and transparency.

1.) Nature of the Event
The function you attended was a Sangeet, and the food service began later than usual, at around 10:00 PM. At that point, the entire gathering approached the food counters simultaneously, which led to brief waiting at certain live counters.

2.) Roti & Laccha Paratha Service
This exact scenario was discussed in detail with the host during menu finalisation. There were two options:
• To stock tandoori rotis/laccha parathas in advance, which affects freshness and temperature, or
• To serve them fresh and hot, with a short waiting time at the counter.

The host consciously chose the second option, with a clear understanding that a wait of 4–5 minutes might occur, as maintaining quality and freshness was the priority.

3.) Food Temperature Clarification
We would also like to clarify that all our buffet setups and live counters operate on electrical chafing systems. We do not use chemical fuel at our venue. Under this system, food being cold is highly unlikely during regular service.

4.) Valet Service
We sincerely apologise if you found the valet service unprofessional or rude. This is certainly not the standard we strive to maintain, and your feedback has been taken seriously. We will be addressing this internally to ensure improved guest interaction.

5.) Food Quality Feedback
Our food quality has consistently been appreciated by clients and guests, as reflected in our past reviews. While concerns regarding taste are rare, we respect all feedback and treat it with due seriousness.

We understand how important such once-in-a-lifetime events are for the hosts, and we assure you that all service decisions were taken in consultation with them, keeping freshness, quality, and overall experience as the top priority.

Thank you once again for your feedback. We remain committed to learning, improving, and delivering the best possible experience to our guests.

Warm regards,
Team Aurous Banquets

Extremely Disappointed with Management — Unprofessional Behavior by Mr. Henri Lobo

We had our wedding at Blossom Lawn, Mahakali on 2nd November 2025, and while the venue itself is decent, the management experience was extremely disappointing and completely spoiled the joy of our special day.

Right from the booking stage, we were told the venue timing was 6 PM to 2 AM, and that any time extension would be chargeable on an hourly basis. All discussions and confirmations were done with Mr. Henri Lobo, who manages the property on lease.

However, on the wedding night itself, around 11:30 PM, his staff started repeatedly asking “Kabhi khatam hoga sab?” while our guests were still enjoying the function. When I reminded them about the time extension arrangement, Mr. Henri Lobo arrived and completely denied our previous discussion in a very rude and unprofessional manner. He even said, “2 AM ke baad agar extend hua to you’ll have to pay ₹50,000,” which was completely unacceptable and disrespectful. His behavior and tone spoiled the atmosphere of our celebration.

That wasn’t the only issue. Just two days before the wedding, it rained heavily, so I messaged Mr. Lobo asking about arrangements to protect guests from the rain. He called and told me that we would have to bear the cost of tarpaulin for rain protection. When I questioned why this was not the venue’s responsibility, he bluntly said, “I am not responsible for it — you have to bear the cost.” He later suggested splitting the cost with another wedding happening on 1st November, and I had no choice but to agree to pay ₹15,000 extra on top of the ₹3.2 lakh venue charge.

My biggest mistake was paying the full amount in advance.I strongly advise others not to make full payment before the event — wait until after the function concludes. Because this advance payment left us helpless, and we had to face unnecessary harassment.

During the wedding rituals, his staff kept interrupting and demanding the remaining ₹15,000 repeatedly — which was highly unethical and disrespectful. Despite all payments being cleared, no arrangements were made for the DWAR POOJA, and I personally had to run around to get it managed.

Overall, the unprofessional attitude, lack of accountability, and rude behavior from the management, especially Mr. Henri Lobo, made what should have been a joyful event extremely stressful.

I would strongly recommend future clients to be cautious, keep all communications in writing, avoid paying the full amount upfront , and double-check every commitment before finalizing anything with this venue.

DO NOT HOST YOUR EVENTS HERE.
PLEASE READ THROUGH.
I am extremely disappointed with the service and hygiene standards of this venue and its management. When someone hosts a function, they expect their special day to run smoothly—not to spend it running around fixing basic issues.
Here is what we experienced:
1.There was no board at the entrance displaying our event name, so guests were confused about whether they were at the right venue.
2.Rats were seen running around the entrance because trash from previous events had been dumped near the food counter area on the pavement.
3.The board of the previous event was still displayed, further confusing our guests. IT WAS NOT MOVED UNTIL WE INFORMED THE STAFF.
4.The washrooms were in the WORST condition — foul smell, visibly unclean, and even feces left in the toilets. The flush was not working. Despite repeatedly informing the staff, we were told it was “clean,” until continuous complaints forced them to unclog and clean the drains.
5.The changing room was dirty, looked more like a storage area, and the door would not close properly.
6. The sofas in both the changing room and the hall were visibly unclean.
7. The roce prop had no spoon, and when we placed roce in it, it leaked.
8. The power tripped twice during the event because the geyser was turned on—something we were never informed about. So to avoid any more tripping the bridesmaid had to have bath in cold water in an already cold weather. Moreover having a power cut during an event in Mumbai is unacceptable and extremely embarrassing.
9. The buffet was delayed by 15–20 minutes because there were no serving spoons. Guests started leaving, and we had to request them to stay, which was again very humiliating.
10. The sweet - Vorn that was promised was not served at all, with staff casually stating that it was “missed.”

We have hosted many events before, and while minor hiccups are understandable, this was by far the worst experience we have ever had. Instead of enjoying our event, we spent the entire time chasing staff to fix, clean, and arrange things that should have been taken care of in advance.

This place is highly unprofessional, unhygienic, and completely unfit for hosting any important function.

I had a horrible experience. I was promised a lot while Henrison and Jude under delivered. I would not recommend this place to anyone.

I booked this place for my roce. The setup wasn't done till 6 pm while the roce was supposed to start at 6.30 pm- Henrison was clearly informed of the start time in advance. The bathrooms weren't clean and the flush was broken, with water continously being wasted. The small changing room was equally dirty, with the entrance door to the room broken. The power tripped twice during the function- which was so embarrassing. Jude, himself, initially admitted he was surprised the power hadn't tripped when the geyser was turned on- I was surprised to hear this since I wasn't informed of this while booking the place. When I confronted Henrison at the end of the event, he lied straight to my face saying the power hadn't tripped at all before this day, it was the first time this had happened, and acted surprised.

We were ready to open the buffet at 8.45 pm but there were no spoons available to serve the dishes. We ended up waiting for the spoons to arrive for another 10-15 minutes while my guests ended up leaving without eating.

We had finalized Vorn for the menu. That wasn't served on the day of the event. Henrison totally forgot about it even though it was given in writing.

There were rats roaming near the gate at the entrance, since the place wasn't clean.

The eisel board also didn't have a full printout of my name. It was a half cut- shoddy job done for namesake. The eisel board was only setup after I called Henrison at 6.15 pm. There was a big cardboard cutout in the venue of someone else's birthday. I had to ask for this to be removed.

The entire event was a mess, as I was running around Jude trying to get things fixed. My function was ruined. Please DO NOT go by the rosey photos provided. You'll end up ruining your special day like me!
